title: Ethiopian Coffee Cheesecake
author: Chef Haile
desc: Ethiopian Coffee Cheesecake — a baked cheesecake infused with Yirgacheffe espresso, cardamom, and Ethiopian honey, on a Dabo Kolo crumb base. The modern Ethiopian café's proudest dessert — celebrating the birthplace of coffee in the cheesecake format.
longDesc: Ethiopian coffee cheesecake is the Addis Ababa café's signature dessert — the globally beloved cheesecake format made completely Ethiopian by using Yirgacheffe espresso, Ethiopian mountain honey, and a Dabo Kolo (traditional crunchy bread) crumb base.
steps: Mix crushed Dabo Kolo with melted butter. Press into lined springform tin. Chill.
Add honey, eggs one at a time, espresso, cardamom, and vanilla.
Bake in a bain marie at 160°C for 55—60 minutes.
Centre should be barely set — slight wobble is correct.
Cool in oven 1 hour (door ajar). Refrigerate 4 hours minimum.
chefTips: The Dabo Kolo base is the Ethiopian innovation — its cardamom-honey flavour pairs perfectly with the coffee filling.
Bain marie is essential — prevents cracking.
Yirgacheffe espresso should be strong — 2 tbsp brewed at espresso concentration.
cookingScience: Cheesecake sets through egg protein coagulation — at 160°C in a bain marie, the water bath limits maximum temperature to 100°C, ensuring gentle, even setting. The slight wobble at removal means the residual heat will complete the setting during cooling.
sustainabilityTips: Yirgacheffe coffee — the world's most sustainable shade-grown coffee origin.
servedWith: With a shot of Yirgacheffe espresso
culturalNote: Ethiopian coffee cheesecake is the Addis Ababa café's proudest statement — 'we invented coffee, and this is what we can do with it'. The Dabo Kolo base, the Yirgacheffe espresso filling, the cardamom note — it is completely Ethiopian in its soul.
